items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Montgomery and I have the honor and the distinct pleasure to announce and interview... Mr. Garvin Bushell.

ctx.x: Garvin Bushell, as you may or may not know, is one of the most exciting musicians of our day and time and it stems back from the very beginning, the early days of jazz music. And I would like to introduce Garvin Bushell by asking him where was his home town and state?

(unintelligible) Monk. Originally I came out of Ohio, was born in Ohio -- Springfield, Ohio, to be exact. They have it stated that I was born in 1902, and in rummaging through some of the effects of my mother when she passed in '68, I found a book stating that I was born in 1900. So, give or take, it was either 1902 or 1900, anyhow, it was very close to the beginning of the 20th Century, in Springfield. As I recollect, there was a very happy atmosphere in Ohio in those days when I was a kid. Nothing but pleasure…
